lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's BOCC meeting, where San Miguel County takes up two Land Use Code amendments — one on Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots, the kind of quiet code language that shapes development for years. On the same day, HARC holds three separate preliminary public hearings on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave, a large multi-building project in an Accommodations 2 zone that's worth watching. Rico's Board of Trustees also meets Tuesday to vote on a water line replacement contract and a lease with the Rico Historical Society.

notable.stake: Three public hearings on large-scale Carhenge redevelopment, multiple new buildings at 700 W Pacific.
